prompt:
Goal: Create a cinematic character design sheet labeled in Spanish for FICHA DE PERSONAJE, showing an elderly wandering Japanese hermit musician and his instrument accessory.

Canvas: Wide horizontal 16:9 concept-art presentation on warm off-white paper, thin gray divider lines, museum catalog / film production design style, realistic photographic rendering with soft studio lighting and subtle shadows.

Layout: Split the sheet into two main columns. The left two-thirds is the character sheet, titled “FICHA DE PERSONAJE” in large spaced serif capitals at the top. The right third is the accessory sheet, titled “ACCESORIO: KOTO” in the same serif style. Use clean rectangular panels, fine borders, and centered small uppercase captions beneath each view.

Character section: Show exactly 5 character views: 3 full-body turnarounds and 2 portrait insets. The 3 full-body views are, from left to right, front labeled “FRENTE,” back labeled “ESPALDA,” and side profile labeled “PERFIL.” The 2 portrait insets are stacked vertically to the right of the full bodies: a tight face close-up labeled “PRIMER PLANO,” and a chest-up three-quarter view labeled “VISTA 3/4.” The character is an elderly man with very long tangled gray-white hair, a massive flowing white beard, dark sunglasses, weathered tan skin, and a calm stoic expression. He wears a wide conical woven straw hat, a shaggy straw rain cloak made of long dry fibers, layered ragged brown robes, a wrapped sash belt, loose trousers, and worn brown boots. The costume should feel ancient, dusty, handmade, and textured, with frayed hems and natural earth tones.

Accessory section: Show exactly 5 views of the instrument accessory: 3 full instrument views across the top labeled “FRENTE,” “PERFIL,” and “ESPALDA,” plus 2 close-up detail panels along the bottom labeled “DETALLE CABEZA” and “DETALLE CUERPO.” The accessory is a rustic vertical string instrument inspired by a koto or shamisen, made from aged dark wood and pale stretched hide, with visible scratches, stains, pegs, strings, and worn varnish. The front view shows the pale hide-covered body, the profile view shows the thin side depth, and the back view shows a dark reddish-brown wooden body.

Visual style: Hyperrealistic fantasy costume reference, high-detail fabric and straw fibers, muted browns, sepia tones, ivory background, elegant editorial spacing, no modern props except the sunglasses. Use Spanish captions exactly as specified, with refined serif typography and thin horizontal rules at the top and bottom.

Constraints: Keep the sheet clean and symmetrical, include exactly 10 labeled visual panels/views total, avoid extra text, avoid watermarks, avoid logos, avoid cartoon styling.
